coder_notes: Rationale links EGFRvIII to autophagy dependence, but chloroquine is not an EGFR-targeting agent and EGFRvIII is only an exploratory outcome, so candidate_matched false. IDH also appears as an exploratory outcome; one row kept (eligibility). [18F]HX4 PET tracer is used only in a single-centre substudy and is not a registered intervention, so not listed (R9). Radiotherapy not an agent. Standard arm is registered NO_INTERVENTION and receives temozolomide; chloroquine given from one week before to end of radiotherapy.
